method: Source-surface right thumb/finger columns. Four-finger longitudinal joint stations and all original bone rotations retained. Original LOD0 masks inspected; lower LODs map to original LOD0 surface by nearest-triangle barycentrics, then retain existing four-finger total weight. No source geometry changes.

geometryMeasurements.lowerLodMapping: Nearest original LOD0 hand-surface triangle, barycentric thumb-mask ownership; original nonfinger share retained for four-finger regions.
geometryMeasurements.mixedWebTransfer: All nonzero index/finger shares at thumb-index web vertices are retained from corrected LOD0 triangle barycentrics; no thumb threshold discards them.
